I need to make a decision for my turn in this Monopoly game.

I own B&O Railroad and Pacific Avenue. I have $962 cash. Other players hold various properties and railroads.

I'm considering trading for Short Line or Pennsylvania RR to complete a railroad monopoly. I need to determine what offer would be acceptable.

Pacific Avenue is too valuable to trade for a railroad early. A trade with p3 would overpay cash and hurt my ability to buy properties on future turns. Blocking p1 from completing orange is a better priority.

I will end my turn. Trading away Pacific or B&O for incomplete sets would be a net loss. p4 has no properties to offer, and I cannot block p1 from completing orange without owning their missing spaces.
